subject: Re: Encyclopedic VQA kickoff: retrieval-augmented visual QA
body:
Priya,

Staffing and scope from my side.

Vera 80% on the eval harness and the retrieval-augmented baseline, Jorge 60% on the knowledge-base serving path (the WikiWeb2M-derived KB needs a proper index, not the CSV downloads), Yara on modeling.

The piece I want on the record: a retrieval-augmented teacher at 48.8%-class accuracy is too heavy to serve at product latency. We're scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe from scratch - Yara owns it end to end, roughly five weeks of work - to compress the retrieval-augmented teacher into something deployable. Recipe covers teacher-trace collection, loss schedule, and eval gates on the single-hop split. It's the long pole for the July pre-read, so it starts now, in parallel with the baseline.

Compute: Titan best-effort for May, and I'll want ~64 reserved GPUs for the June distillation runs - request going to Ines this week.

Daniela
